title: TX-100 Fractionation Protocol
author: Scott Vermilyea
materials: This is TNE crude lysate (no detergents).
Supernatant from this is the insoluble fraction .

steps.title: Thaw Tissue
steps.instruction: If tissue is stored at -80 °C, thaw it by placing it at -20 °C for at least 4 hours or overnight prior to homogenization.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1X TNE supplemented with phosphatase and protease inhibitors.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue gently on ice using either a mechanical Dounce homogenizer or a homogenizer machine.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 volumes of 1X TNE (10 µL of TNE per 1 mg of tissue; e.g., 500 µL for 50 mg tissue).

steps.title: Triton X-100 Treatment
steps.instruction: Treat the homogenized tissue with Triton X-100 (Tx100).

substeps.instruction: Take a specific volume of tissue in TNE and add an equal volume of 1X TNE containing 2% Triton X-100 (e.g., 150 µL tissue + 150 µL 1X TNE+2% Tx100).

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash and resuspend the resulting pellet.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet in 150 µL of 1X TNE+1% Tx100 (using the same volume that was used for the tissue in the previous step).
Resuspend the pellet in 75 µL to 100 µL of cTNE.

steps.title: Secondary Sonication and Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Sonicate and centrifuge the resuspended pellet to separate fractions.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate at 4 °C for 3 cycles (00:00:10 ON / 00:00:02 OFF).
Spin down at 16,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Fractionation Centrifugation Options
steps.instruction: Perform further centrifugation based on the chosen option to separate soluble and insoluble fractions.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C.
Option 2: Centrifuge at 20,000 x g for 1 hour at 4 °C.

steps.title: Process Soluble Fraction
steps.instruction: Isolate and prepare the soluble fraction from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Save the supernatant (soluble fraction) and add an equal volume of complete TNE (cTNE).
Sonicate at 4 °C for 3 cycles (00:00:10 ON / 00:00:02 OFF).
Spin down at 16,000 x g for 15 minutes at 4 °C; the resulting supernatant is the soluble fraction.
Spin down using one of the following options: Option 1 (16,000 x g, 4 °C, 15 minutes) or Option 2 (20,000 x g, 4 °C, 1 hour; or 25,000 x g, temperature not specified).
